title: Segfault in `new_empty_strided`

labels.name: module: crash
labels.description: Problem manifests as a hard crash, as opposed to a RuntimeError

labels.name: triaged
labels.description: This issue has been looked at a team member, and triaged and prioritized into an appropriate module

labels.name: module: edge cases
labels.description: Adversarial inputs unlikely to occur in practice

body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

Looks like insufficient input validation. Segfaults with this repro:

```py
import torch

dtype = torch.float64
device = 'cpu'
pin_memory = False
layout = None

x = torch.tensor(-4.8270, dtype=torch.float64)
size = (2,)
stride = ()


res = x.new_empty_strided(
    size,
    stride,
    dtype=dtype,
    device=device,
    pin_memory=pin_memory,
    layout=layout,
)

print(res.stride())
print(res)
```
